title: Blue Mountain Beach "Sunrise Cottage" 125 Seaward Drive
h1: Blue Mountain Beach "Sunrise Cottage" 125 Seaward Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf views- Hot tub- Gas grill- Large family deck- Gated community- 3 adult bikes- 2 available parking spaces- Complimentary beach setups each morning include 2 beach chairs with 2 umbrellas (Mar 1-Oct 31)- Complete Clean Linen Participant—ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: When the beach and sea call, escape to Sunrise Cottage! Set along the Gulf coast, this 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom Blue Mountain Beach home comfortably accommodates 7 guests. Picture days of sandy toes, sun-drenched adventures on the coastal dune lakes, charming boutiques, and local art galleries. Guests will love beginning each day with sweeping Gulf views and taking advantage of the convenient beach access—right off the back deck!Framed by palm trees against a dreamy beach backdrop, this 3-level home is a picture-perfect 30A getaway. The first level features a shaded seating area and sitting space where guests can enjoy the peaceful atmosphere—the rolling dunes offer natural privacy. A few steps away is a grill for barbecuing burgers and hot dogs.Take the exterior staircase to the main floor to find an open living, dining, and kitchen space adorned in breezy, coastal-chic décor. The true star of the space is the nearly 180-degree vista of the Gulf’s resplendent waters showcased by numerous oversized windows. Curl up on the slip-covered sofa and loveseat to take in the view while gathered with loved ones. For entertainment, there’s a 65” Smart TV to the side. The kitchen is equipped with Bosch and LG appliances, plus 2 coffeemakers, and a 6-person dining table. If eating alfresco is preferred, the Gulf-front balcony hosts high-top tables and leads to a table for 6 on the beach walkover. Enjoy a peaceful night’s rest at bedtime in the guest bedroom with a king bed, Roku TV, and private balcony.The primary bedroom is on the top floor, boasting a king bed, private bathroom, Roku TV, and a balcony overlooking the Gulf. Additionally, there is a guest bedroom with a king bed, Smart TV, and balcony, as well as an additional sleeping area with a comfortable twin bed.Sunrise Cottage offers an idyllic Blue Mountain Beach retreat with beach access off the back deck, awe-inspiring views, and relaxing outdoor spaces. Parking for 2 vehicles and 3 complimentary adult bikes makes it easy to explore local attractions, including Point Washington State Forest. Book today for an amazing 30A getaway!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 7):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate, and Balcony Access- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Additional Sleeping Area: Twin Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo

Set along the Gulf coast, this 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom Blue Mountain Beach home comfortably accommodates 7 guests. Picture days of sandy toes, sun-drenched adventures on the coastal dune lakes, charming boutiques, and local art galleries. Guests will love beginning each day with sweeping Gulf views and taking advantage of the convenient beach access—right off the back deck! Framed by palm trees against a dreamy beach backdrop, this 3-level home is a picture-perfect 30A getaway. A few steps away is a grill for barbecuing burgers and hot dogs. Take the exterior staircase to the main floor to find an open living, dining, and kitchen space adorned in breezy, coastal-chic décor. Curl up on the slip-covered sofa and loveseat to take in the view while gathered with loved ones. For entertainment, there’s a 65” Smart TV to the side. Enjoy a peaceful night’s rest at bedtime in the guest bedroom with a king bed, Roku TV, and private balcony. The primary bedroom is on the top floor, boasting a king bed, private bathroom, Roku TV, and a balcony overlooking the Gulf. Additionally, there is a guest bedroom with a king bed, Smart TV, and balcony, as well as an additional sleeping area with a comfortable twin bed. Sunrise Cottage offers an idyllic Blue Mountain Beach retreat with beach access off the back deck, awe-inspiring views, and relaxing outdoor spaces. Parking for 2 vehicles and 3 complimentary adult bikes makes it easy to explore local attractions, including Point Washington State Forest. Book today for an amazing 30A getaway!
